description: In pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs line 221, SmimeProfile sets max_validity_secs = Some(1185 * 86_400) with the comment 'approximately 39 calendar months. Approximated as 1185 days; exact calendar-month enforcement requires notBefore date arithmetic not available in ValidationPolicy.' 1185 days = 39.5 months (not 39), and the S/MIME BR actually specifies ~825 days for some certificate types. The approximation should cite the exact S/MIME BR section and ballot version, and the rounding direction (1185 > ~39 months) should be explained as lenient-in-favor-of-cert rather than conservative. This is a documentation/accuracy issue, P3.
title: pkix-profiles SmimeProfile approximates calendar months as 1185 days without spec reference for the approximation
